title: Big bands and shows versus small groups
summary: Dance notes Zutty's early career was in big bands and shows, harder work; Zutty recalls the Connie's Inn show and how his Lyric Theater experience helped him catch dancers' moves with the ratchet.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well what is kind of interesting you know, since the latter part of your life you've mostly played with small groups. All your early experience was with big bands, wasn't it really? Well I mean, you had, I know you had small bands in the earlier stage, but you had a lot of big band experience too.
And playing shows, I mean that's about one of the roughest things to do.

That show in Connie's Inn was really something, boy. Then all that happened in New Orleans while playing at the Lyric Theater with old man Robichaux. See, I had a little experience on that see? And that's why I could catch guys in different ratchet. You know, like cats used to make a split and pull their pants up. That was for the ratchet you know.
